sources.title: Agenda Center
sources.purpose: Searchable agendas, minutes, and downloads for City boards, commissions, and Council meetings.
useFor: finding meeting notices and agenda packets
checking whether minutes are draft or posted
capturing meeting date and body
limits: The page says older material may be in the Document Center. Draft minutes may change before approval.

sources.title: The Buffalo Common Council
sources.purpose: Official Council context, district information, and links to live or recorded meeting access.
useFor: confirming the legislative body and district
finding Council meeting video links
routing a question to the Council
limits: A livestream or social-media recording is contextual evidence. Use the official agenda and minutes for the formal item and vote.

sources.title: Open Data Buffalo
sources.purpose: City datasets that can support a public decision or outcome claim, such as permits, violations, property sales, and service records.
useFor: finding a dataset by topic
recording dataset definition and update date
linking a claim to a row or query
limits: Dataset pages carry their own disclaimers and may not be the City's complete official record. Do not infer causation or intent from correlation.

sources.title: FOIL Requests
sources.purpose: City portal for requesting records that are not already publicly posted.
useFor: checking whether a request or released record exists
submitting a narrowly described City record request
logging request and response dates
limits: FOIL access is subject to statutory exemptions, redactions, fees, and agency custody. The portal does not prove that an unposted record does not exist.

sources.title: Session Agendas & Minutes
sources.purpose: County legislative agendas, minutes, public-hearing notices, live links, and prior-session archives.
useFor: tracking a local law or resolution
comparing introduced, amended, and adopted items
saving the county's item number and packet
limits: Use the County's stated status and date. A listed agenda item may be postponed, amended, or not adopted.

sources.title: Public Information/FOIL
sources.purpose: County Legislature FOIL officer, appeal contact, and records-access routing.
useFor: routing a Legislature record request
capturing the responsible officer and appeal path
logging correspondence
limits: This page covers the Legislature. Other county offices have separate records officers and processes.

sources.title: Official Records Public Search
sources.purpose: Public search for recorded instruments that may substantiate a property, contracting, or ownership claim.
useFor: checking the recording trail
capturing instrument number, book/page, party, and date
limits: The Clerk says the index is not searchable by property address. A record search is not a legal opinion or complete investigation.

sources.title: Open Government
sources.publisher: New York State Committee on Open Government
sources.purpose: Official guidance, law text, sample letters, and advisory materials for FOIL and the Open Meetings Law.
useFor: understanding the source's access vocabulary
finding current sample FOIL or appeal language
checking OML and FOIL guidance
limits: Guidance is not a case-specific legal opinion. A particular agency may have its own officer, portal, schedule, or exemption.

sources.title: Open NY
sources.purpose: State public datasets for context, funding, health, environment, transportation, and other public decisions.
useFor: finding a State dataset
capturing its owner, definition, date, and row identifier
cross-checking a local claim with State data
limits: Each dataset has its own coverage and quality notes. A State dataset may not be the official record for a local action.

sources.title: Federal Register
sources.publisher: Office of the Federal Register, National Archives
sources.purpose: Official federal notices, proposed rules, final rules, meetings, and public-comment opportunities.
useFor: checking whether a federal notice exists
capturing document number, agency, publication date, and comment deadline
limits: A Federal Register notice may announce a process rather than a final decision. Follow the notice's own instructions and dates.

sources.title: FOIA.gov
sources.purpose: Federal records-request guidance, agency links, and FOIA process information.
useFor: finding the federal agency that holds a record
submitting or tracking a federal FOIA request
recording a response or appeal path
limits: FOIA has exemptions, agency-specific procedures, fees, and delays. It does not create a record that an agency does not maintain.
